stem:
A laboratory culture of bacteria is counted every 2 hours. The number N of bacteria after t hours is modelled by N = N₀e^{kt}.
t (hours): 0, 2, 4, 6, 8
N: 250, 503, 1014, 2042, 4111

parts.label: a
parts.text: Show that the model N = N₀e^{kt} gives a straight line when ln N is plotted against t, and state what the gradient and intercept represent.
parts.answer: ln N = ln N₀ + kt; gradient k, intercept ln N₀
parts.working: M1 take ln of both sides; A1 gradient k, vertical intercept ln N₀.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Calculate the values of ln N for the table, correct to 2 decimal places, and use them to estimate k and N₀.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Use the model to estimate the number of bacteria after 10 hours, correct to 2 significant figures, and comment on the reliability of this estimate.
parts.answer: About 8300; it is an extrapolation beyond the data, so less reliable
